payload.model_patch:
diff --git a/sympy/utilities/codegen.py b/sympy/utilities/codegen.py
index f0befb2bd7..644c1683da 100644
--- a/sympy/utilities/codegen.py
+++ b/sympy/utilities/codegen.py
@@ -197,6 +197,13 @@ def __init__(self, name, arguments, results, local_vars, global_vars):
             raise ValueError("Symbols needed for output are not in input " +
                              ", ".join([str(x) for x in notcovered]))
 
+        # Ensure that InputArguments that are MatrixSymbols are treated as
+        # array arguments even if they don't appear in the expressions.
+        for arg in arguments:
+            if isinstance(arg, InputArgument) and isinstance(arg.name, MatrixSymbol):
+                if arg.dimensions is None:
+                    arg.dimensions = arg.name.shape
+
         self.name = name
         self.arguments = arguments
         self.results = results
